review_notes: I read the whole file and checked the declarations it relies on in QuasiValue.lean and Kaplansky/StableFiniteness/Definitions.lean. I also searched Mathlib for a ClosedStarIdeal-like structure and found none. `QuasiValue` is a custom structure for this project (a quasi-trace-like value on a C*-algebra), and I know of no Mathlib counterpart. `ClosedStarIdeal` is defined in the repo, not in this file, and Mathlib has no equivalent for closed self-adjoint two-sided ideals of C*-algebras. `nullIdeal V` is a useful named specialisation of it. `IsNull` and `continuous_squareVal` partly overlap with the repo's own `QuasiValue.q` in QuasiValue.lean. That is internal duplication, not a competing version of a Mathlib concept, so it is outside this rubric. The lemmas in this file are theorem-level results, which the rubric excludes. I found no justified finding.
